A '''moll''' was a companion of a [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]]<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> or a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="StarByStar">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> Molls found the [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to be entertaining.<ref name="EGtPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
